gepa_selected.instruction: Carefully analyze the text to identify the primary emotion expressed, considering context and dominant keywords, and output the corresponding capital letter from the label mapping.

interpretation: GEPA-selected and post-hoc-audit-best are reported separately. The post-hoc audit is exploratory and does not retroactively change GEPA acceptance.

posthoc_audit_best.instruction: Carefully analyze the text to identify the primary emotion expressed, focusing on dominant keywords and context, and output the corresponding capital letter from the label mapping.

seed.instruction: Carefully determine the main emotion the writer expresses from the label mapping, ignore incidental details, and output only the corresponding capital letter.
